Completion means the strategy may close the span, not that it must close immediately if continuing the expression is still semantically useful. 4. Use variables only when they genuinely help. Do not round or truncate decimals like 8.5 into 8, do not replace values like 13 with 1, and prefer copying all relevant numbers from the question into the expression before simplifying. 6.
